newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Union Bank in HK$505 mln equity issue.
newsitem.headline: Union Bank in HK$505 mln equity issue.

text.p: Union Bank of Hong Kong Ltd said on Friday it would issue 45 million new shares to raise HK$505.35 million after expenses to expand its branch network.
The shares, equivalent to 15.58 percent of the bank's enlarged share capital, will be priced at HK$11.35 and taken up by the parent company China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd.
This follows the parent's placing of 24.48 million existing Union Bank shares to institutional investors.
On completion of the transactions on March 24, China Merchants' stake in Union Bank would be diluted to about 60 percent from the present 62.66 percent, the bank said.

Proceeds of the subscription would be used to expand the bank's branch network in Hong Kong and to strengthen it's capital base. This would then enable it to accelerate expansion of its loan portfolio.
The bank reported a 20.1 percent rise in 1996 net profit to HK$270.42 million on Thursday.
Union Bank ended the Friday morning session HK$0.10 lower at HK$11.75.
